claims.quote: Ancistrus claro, the gold marble bristlenose catfish (LDA 008), is a suckermouth catfish from the rios Claro and Coxipó in Mato Grosso, Brazil.
Type locality is 'Rio Claro, above the bridge, in the direction of Chappada dos Guimaraes, Mato Grosso State, Brazil'.
